clusters.name: Your grandfather Amos's death, 1989–1990
clusters.reason: Around your grandfather Amos's death in July 1989, within the following months: your mother lying awake over money in March 1988, then stopping talk with your father about it in May 1988; your brother's grades falling in November 1989; and your mother calmer once back at work in March 1990. The shifts in these months belong together as the family moved through a loss, and your mother's settling marks where the period closes.

clusters.name: Your mother Della told she had breast cancer, 1993–1996
clusters.reason: Around your mother Della's diagnosis in February 1995, within the months before and after: you left home for college in September 1993, then your migraines kept you in bed in March 1994, and you called your brother most nights in April 1994; your mother's diagnosis came in February 1995, and by June 1995 you stopped returning your brother's calls, then by February 1996 you stopped calling home. Each shift lies near another's across these years, and your distance from home settles by 1996, so the period closes there.
